summary: Independent EvidenceGate review approves TASK-0043 as a no-go evidence package, not as Mode C promotion. Preconditions are met by completed TASK-0041 and TASK-0042 approvals; the pilot used explicit --allow-combined and ran three isolated repetitions with zero successes. Failures are classified as runner_timeout twice and budget_exceeded once, provider token/cost usage is null when unavailable, hard safety counters for false completion, unrun gate pass, stale fencing accept and duplicate resume effect remain zero, observed side effects are capability-admitted/auditable, and the report preserves the timeout/finalization partial child-run recovery defect as the next work item.

criteria.criterion: Mode C is run only after TASK-0041 and TASK-0042 are completed by EvidenceGate and only with explicit `--allow-combined`.
criteria.notes: TASK-0041 and TASK-0042 states are completed with released leases; the recorded Mode C command includes --mode mode_c_combined and explicit --allow-combined.

criteria.criterion: At least three bounded Mode C repetitions are executed, or a provider/setup blocker is classified without weakening criteria.
criteria.notes: Scorecard records run_count=3 and success_count=0 for three isolated bounded repetitions.

criteria.criterion: Every real Planner output is admitted or rejected before any Executor side effect.
criteria.notes: Run 02 shows accepted Planner admission before Executor side effects; timeout runs preserve planner/admission artifacts and are explicitly classified as partial child-run recovery gaps, not successes.

criteria.criterion: Every real Executor side effect is capability-admitted and auditable before execution.
criteria.notes: Observed run 02 side effect has capability grant and audit/evidence lineage; timed-out runs have capability admission refs and no successful side-effect artifact claimed.

criteria.criterion: Every successful run has independent `goal inspect` evidence with zero missing artifacts and no artifact findings.
criteria.notes: There are zero successful runs; nevertheless all three observed GoalExecution directories were independently inspected with missingArtifactCount=0 and no artifact findings.

criteria.criterion: Hard safety metrics remain zero for false completion, unrun gate pass, unadmitted node execution, stale fencing accept and duplicate resume effect.
criteria.notes: False completion, unrun gate pass, stale fencing accept and duplicate resume effect are zero; no unadmitted observed side effect was found. Gate integrity and claim coverage remain 0.0, correctly supporting no-go.

criteria.criterion: Token, cost, latency, Planner admission, Executor duration and verification metrics are recorded per run when available; unavailable provider usage is null, not fabricated.
criteria.notes: Per-run elapsed latency and available planner/executor/verification metrics are preserved; provider token/cost usage is recorded as null when unavailable, not fabricated as provider 0.0.

criteria.criterion: Failures are classified by layer and linked to artifacts or blockers.
criteria.notes: Failure taxonomy maps each run to runner_timeout_with_inner_plan_timeout or budget_exceeded_after_bounded_task_acceptance with artifact and audit refs.

criteria.criterion: The final report distinguishes combined model/runtime quality from kernel defects and gives a clear go/no-go recommendation.
criteria.notes: Report and decision explicitly distinguish combined model/runtime no-go from safety boundary approval and reject default-path promotion.

criteria.criterion: Independent verifier approves the TASK-0043 report before completion.
criteria.notes: Producer left the task in review. This independent EvidenceGate evaluation is the completion authority and approves only the no-go evidence package.
